t0179-01.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
t0179-01.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

t0179-02.gloss: A test strip and a shoe warning share the course grounds log.
t0179-02.rival_reading: A response team could mark off a ditch during a cleanup; the note does not identify what was applied to the strip.
